integrity: Two separately implemented full-state exhaustive algorithms and a complete geometric automorphism check are embedded as source and expected outputs. All claims are limited to these exact hypotheses and to reproducibility conditional on faithful execution.
scientific_limitations: The claim is a finite exhaustive classification for the sixteen-vertex Q4 and exact three-state synchronous two-contact rule, not a general higher-dimensional theorem. Historical priority is best-knowledge only; independent external audit remains unperformed.
title: Eighteen affine four-waves under two-contact excitation on the four-cube
